Understanding Glo Corporate Gifting vs. Retail Data Plans

To get the best value, you should understand the difference between standard retail plans and Corporate Gifting (CG) plans. Retail plans are what you get when you dial *312# on your Glo line. They are expensive and often contain day/night splits (e.g., giving you 10GB but restricting 5GB of it to night use from 12 AM to 5 AM, which is useless for daytime workers, students, or remote employees, who need active daytime internet).

Corporate Gifting data, on the other hand, is a wholesale enterprise service. Large companies buy huge data pools and share them with employees. Wholesale VTU portals purchase these pools and distribute them to subscribers. Glo Corporate Gifting data has no time restrictions—you can use 100% of your data at any time of day for any app, website, or device, including modems, tablets, and home routers, without any speed throttling, maximizing your internet utility.

How to Check Your Glo Data Balance (Unified Codes)
Checking your Glo data balance can vary based on whether you purchased a standard retail bundle or a Corporate Gifting plan. To ensure you always get the right balance readout, use these codes:

items: Unified USSD Code: Dial *310# on your Glo line (replaces the old *127*0# code). A pop-up menu will display your active data balance and expiration date.
SMS Verification: Send the word 'INFO' as a text message to 127. You will receive an automated SMS breakdown of your remaining megabytes.
Glo Portal: Visit hsi.glo.com on your device while connected to the Glo network to view your dashboard dynamically.

sections.content: Data Preserving Tips for Glo Network Users

Because Glo bundles are generous, users often forget to monitor their device settings, leading to rapid data consumption. To get the best value from your cheap Glo data, configure your device settings. Turn on 'Data Saver' mode on your phone, restrict background app updates, and set video qualities on streaming apps (like YouTube and TikTok) to standard definition (480p) instead of high definition (1080p). These adjustments can extend your data validity by up to 40%.

Additionally, check your device's photo and video backup settings. Apps like Google Photos or iCloud are configured by default to automatically back up large media files over cellular networks. Restricting backups to Wi-Fi only will prevent sudden data drainage, ensuring your wholesale Glo data is spent on active browsing rather than silent backup syncs, saving you money.
